pg_data_dir.description: Path to the PostgreSQL data directory (contains PG_VERSION, base/, pg_wal/, etc.)

pg_bin_dir.description: Path to the PostgreSQL binary directory (pg_ctl, psql, etc.)

pg_config_file.description: Relative or absolute path to the main PostgreSQL config file (inside data_dir or elsewhere)

pg_hba_file.description: Relative or absolute path to the PostgreSQL client authentication config file

replication_use_slots.description: Enable PostgreSQL replication slots to prevent WAL preemption

replication_use_pg_rewind.description: Use pg_rewind to sync failover replicas instead of full base backup (requires WAL archiving)

pg_params.description: Key-value map of PostgreSQL runtime parameters to set (e.g., shared_buffers = '256MB')

superuser_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL superuser account

superuser_password.description: Password for the PostgreSQL superuser (must be set securely in production)

replicator_name.description: Name of the user used for streaming replication

replicator_password.description: Password for the replication user (must be set securely)

cluster_scope.description: Namespace/scope for the cluster within the DCS — ensures separation between multiple Patroni clusters

node_name.description: Unique hostname/identifier for this Patroni node (must be unique within the cluster)

dcs_type.description: Distributed configuration store backend to use for cluster coordination

dcs_hosts.description: List of DCS host addresses (host:port) — one per DCS instance

dcs_port.description: Port for Consul (ignored for other DCS backends)

dcs_username.description: Optional username for ZooKeeper or etcd authentication

dcs_password.description: Optional password for ZooKeeper or etcd authentication

dcs_scheme.description: Protocol to use for Consul (http or https)

dcs_verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify TLS certificates for Consul (set to false only for testing)

dcs_use_ssl.description: Whether to use TLS for ZooKeeper or etcd

dcs_ca_path.description: Path to CA certificate for TLS with etcd

dcs_cert_path.description: Path to client certificate for TLS with etcd

dcs_key_path.description: Path to client private key for TLS with etcd

k8s_namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace to use for Patroni resources (ConfigMap/Endpoints)

restapi_listen.description: IP address for Patroni REST API to bind to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)

restapi_port.description: HTTP port for Patroni REST API

restapi_certfile.description: Path to TLS certificate file for REST API

restapi_keyfile.description: Path to TLS private key file for REST API

restapi_admin_user.description: Username for admin REST API endpoints (e.g., /failover)

restapi_admin_password.description: Password for admin REST API access

bootstrap_ttl.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for session locks in DCS — controls failover detection speed

bootstrap_loop_wait.description: Interval (seconds) between Patroni retry loops (e.g., health checks)

bootstrap_retry_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for DCS operations before retrying

bootstrap_max_lag.description: Maximum lag in bytes before a replica is excluded from failover target

bootstrap_sync_mode.description: Enable synchronous replication mode during bootstrap (recommended for critical data

bootstrap_superuser.description: Whether to create the superuser account during bootstrap (if true, superuser_* must be set)

bootstrap_replicator.description: Whether to create the replication user account during bootstrap

bootstrap_initdb.description: Key-value initdb options (e.g., for encoding, locale, or checksums)

bootstrap_pg_hba.description: List of pg_hba.conf rules to include in the bootstrap cluster

watchdog_mode.description: Watchdog behavior: off, automatic (allow failover only if watchdog is OK), or mandatory (require watchdog)

watchdog_device.description: Path to the watchdog device (e.g., /dev/watchdog or /dev/misc/watchdog)

watchdog_safety_margin.description: Additional time (seconds) to wait before watchdog-triggered fencing after timeout

node_nofailover.description: Prevent this node from becoming primary (use for reporting-only replicas)

node_noloadbalance.description: Exclude this node from load-balancing by read replicas or clients

node_clonefrom.description: Prefer this node as a clone source for new replicas (useful for dedicated backup nodes)
